title: PX-AUD-016 Windows/Linux/macOS evidence binding
root_cause: OS support declarations and old smoke receipts are not equivalent to current revision-bound execution proof.
source_requirement: Bind exact Windows and Linux artifact evidence and classify absent macOS execution honestly.
implementation_steps: Verify OS, VS Code version, extension version, result, and artifact binding.
Separate historical exact-artifact proof from successor proof.
negative_cases: A workflow declaration is not execution evidence.
Windows/Linux success cannot stand in for macOS.
evidence_required: Exact Windows/Linux receipt hashes and explicit macOS disposition.
acceptance_criteria: Windows and Linux are accurately bound to immutable 0.6.83.
macOS remains BLOCKED_BY_EXTERNAL_OS_AUTHORITY until a real run exists.
